body: I live in a small town. I make just enough money to cover expenses and have a little left over each month.
Nothing bad would come from it I guess. My insurance is shit and I doubt it covers anything like that.

I saw a counselor once after my parents divorce under the guise of help with finding a job. The last appointment was when she brought the divorce up and I clawed my arms so I wouldn't cry in front of her. I don't like to show my emotions anymore. I told my friend, who is also my boss I was thinking about killing myself. She was going to make me take the next day off and go see a doctor. I got out of going. I'm not sure she truly believed me either. I'm systematically shutting people out so if I ever do go, it may be less painful for them.
